comments.body:
I had a worse experience where I was in Paris 8 Univ ( a random school). I was keeping receiving random messages from a weird library list for over a week and one morning I can’t stand it so I sent “please remove me from the list”. (I never signed up for it and there is no way to unsubscribe.)

Then everyone receives the message. (I think all students in the uni.)

And then they start replying too, asking for being removed from the email list. There are requests like this every other minute, some are even questioning the legitimacy of how the library has their mails.  

The bombing lasted for several hours and in the afternoon the school has to fix this and finally the weird library list disappeared 😂.
comments.author: Warm_Tough_4290
